value.signature: fn content_pair_matches (body : & ProposalBody , content : & ContentPreDigest , pair : Option < & ContentPair > ,) -> Result < bool , ProfileError >

review.body: { received (& body . structural . id , content) ? ; let Some (pair) = pair else { return Ok (false) ; } ; if body . structural . content == ContentRequest :: FullEmpty && payload_length (& pair . payload) ? != 0 { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } let recomputed = content_pre_digest (& body . structural . id , pair) ? ; if ! same_content (& content . bytes , & recomputed . bytes) { return Err (ProfileError :: Mismatch) ; } Ok (true) }
review.item_premise: The public body, identity and final commitments are recorded completely. Content pairs, both nonces, salts, dependency lists and pre-digests stay in secrecy carriers with redacted Debug; only the admitted final residues, representation refusals and explicit carriage-equality result leave their inventoried boundaries. No entropy, freshness or authority is inferred.
